blurb: Welcome to Tucson Dragway - America’s friendliest racetrack, and a true sportsman racer’s paradise! From September through June, the track offers regular racing with perfectly prepped 1/8 and ¼ mile events, an experienced safety crew, and expansive paved pit space. When northern tracks shut down to wait out the gray days of winter, Tucson Dragway is racing under blue skies and daily highs in the 70s.
